title: Spike: remote herdr fleet recipe
description: Document-first probe of herdr --remote for worker fleets on another machine: what --remote actually attaches (client vs server), what a remote herd run needs (remote herdr server + repo checkout + tk + agent CLIs + auth), how tk herd would target it (HERDR_SOCKET_PATH over SSH forward?), and the moshi-host fit. Deliverable: docs/design/experiments/remote-fleet.md with an exact step-by-step recipe ready to execute live the moment a host is named. No live remote work in this spike unless a host is provided.
closed_reason: Completed: remote-fleet recipe — orchestrator-on-remote works today with zero code (attach via --remote to watch); local-orchestrator/remote-fleet mode needs a remote-aware durable layer, documented as the gap
